summary: Adds a benchmark script under scripts/ that builds a ~40MB db and times db.all() and a search, to show whether JSONStorage re-parsing the file is why reads are slow.
narrative: The owner asked for numbers on slow reads of ~40MB db files, suspecting JSONStorage re-parses the whole file on every query. They wanted a small benchmark script under scripts/ that generates a large db and times db.all() and a search, plus an explanation of where the time goes. Memory holds only this opening ask. It has no observations, PRs or work-state items, so no work or result is recorded yet.

milestones.text: Owner asked for a benchmark script and a breakdown of where read time goes on ~40MB db files

preferences.preference: Wants measured numbers before acting on a performance hunch
preferences.quote: I think JSONStorage re-parses the whole file on every query, but I'd like numbers.
